title: Document Vulkan GPU setup as superseded by HIP
description:
Document that the older Vulkan device setup path is superseded by the HIP/ROCm backend direction for epic `806eb14e`.

## Background

This issue previously requested Vulkan compute infrastructure. The confirmed scope for `806eb14e` is HIP/ROCm only, using `gf2-kernels-hip`. This cleanup task preserves the historical decision and prevents workers from implementing an obsolete Vulkan path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] The issue no longer asks workers to add Vulkan or `vulkano` dependencies.
- [hard] The cleanup note records HIP/ROCm as the selected backend for this epic and links to `dev/plans/hip_gpu_prototype_wave.md`.
- [hard] Any still-useful requirements from the original task are either already covered by HIP evidence infrastructure or explicitly marked out of scope.
- [hard] Default workspace CI remains unaffected.

## Notes

No production code changes are expected unless a stale reference to this Vulkan task needs to be removed from planning docs.
